name: Eichelhardt (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Eichelhardt (an acorn on red above crossed hammers on yellow).
history: The municipality bears arms, a hoisted flag and a banner; the simple two-coloured arrangement of the flags emphasises the canting arms, and their colours take up the flag colours of the Verbandsgemeinde Altenkirchen-Flammersfeld and of the Landkreis.
